title: Weighted Power Fréchet Means in Metric Spaces with Curvature Bounded Above
summary: We establish non-asymptotic risk bounds for power Fréchet means in geodesic metric spaces with curvature bounded above. The observations form weighted, possibly infinite sequences of independent random variables whose laws and means may differ. We treat three settings. For $2$-Fréchet means in Hadamard spaces, we obtain a sharp mean squared error bound that becomes an identity in Hilbert spaces.
